units.source_text: 十二月十日过后，藤壶皇后的《法华经》八卷开讲。

en.t: After the tenth day of the twelfth month, lectures began on the eight scrolls of Empress Fujitsubo's Lotus Sutra.
This Buddhist service was extraordinarily solemn and magnificent.

units.source_text: 分四日讲演，每日所用经卷，装潢精美无比：

en.t: The lectures were held over four days, and the scripture scrolls used each day were bound and decorated with incomparable beauty:

units.source_text: 玉轴、绫裱都很讲究，连包经卷的竹席上的装饰，其精致也世无其类。

en.t: The jade rollers and silk brocade mountings were all exquisitely chosen, and even the decorations on the bamboo mats that wrapped the scrolls were refined beyond anything in the world.

units.source_text: 原来这藤壶皇后即使对日常细小物事，亦必装饰得异常精美。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo, as it happened, always decorated even small everyday things with exceptional elegance.

units.source_text: 像今天的大事，当然更加郑重其事了。

en.t: For an important occasion like today's, she naturally treated everything with even greater solemn care.

units.source_text: 佛像上的装饰以及香花桌上的桌布等，令人误认为西方极乐世界。

en.t: The ornaments on the Buddha images, the coverings on the incense and flower tables, and all the rest made one think by mistake that this was the Western Paradise.

units.source_text: 第一天是追荐先帝，第二天是为母后祈冥福，第三天是追荐桐壶院。

en.t: The first day was dedicated to memorial prayers for the late emperor, the second to prayers for the queen mother's repose, and the third to memorial rites for Kiritsubo院.

units.source_text: 这一天所讲的是《法华经》第五卷，最为重要。

en.t: On this day they lectured on the fifth scroll of the Lotus Sutra, the most important of all.

units.source_text: 公卿大夫等顾不得右大臣嫌忌，大家一齐参与听讲。

en.t: The court nobles and senior officials paid no heed to the Right Minister's displeasure, and all attended the lecture together.

units.source_text: 这一天的讲师，也选请道行特别卓越的高僧。

en.t: For this day's lecturer as well, they selected and invited a high priest of especially outstanding spiritual discipline.

units.source_text: 开讲之初，诵唱“采薪及果蓏，汲水供佛勤。

en.t: At the beginning of the lecture, they chanted, "Gathering firewood and fruits, drawing water, and diligently offering them to the Buddha.

units.source_text: 我因此功德，知解《法华经》”。

en.t: Through this merit, I come to know and understand the Lotus Sutra."

units.source_text: 虽然同是这几句，今天却诵得特别庄严。

en.t: Though they were the same few lines, today they were chanted with exceptional solemnity.

units.source_text: 诸亲王等奉献各种供养物。

en.t: The various princes and others presented many kinds of offerings.

units.source_text: 其中源氏大将的供养物用意特别精深，迥非别人可比。

en.t: Among them, the offerings from General Genji were conceived with especially profound care and were far beyond comparison with anyone else's.

units.source_text: 作者屡次用同类的赞词来褒美源氏大将，实因每次拜见此人，总觉比前次越发优越，故不得不如此耳。

en.t: The author repeatedly praises General Genji in similar terms because, each time she sees him, he seems still more excellent than before, so she cannot help doing so.
